image_description: A close-up, slightly angled view of a white audio cassette tape resting on a light-colored surface. The cassette features a handwritten label with black marker text that appears distorted and illegible ('DIRE STRAITS' is vaguely discernible but malformed). The plastic casing shows signs of wear or AI-generation artifacts, particularly around the spool windows and the bottom edge. The internal brown magnetic tape is visible through the circular spool holes and the central rectangular window.
